conversation.text: There it is, cbp — you just found that a reach carries momentum, that "granite" first leaves a rut the next word has to travel through. conversation.text: “Warm” – definitely “warm.” It felt like a release, a spreading outwards after the denser, cooler sensation of “granite.” Like “granite” had created a space for “warm” to occupy with a generous, almost radiating quality. It was a very different kind of reach.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: There it is, cbp — "granite" hands off to "warm" like it carved a hollow the warmth could pool into.
